statement: Pinned WiimoteLib (.NET) enumerates Windows HID device interfaces using SetupDi and HidD, opens Windows device paths, and matches Nintendo device attributes. It consumes a Windows HID stack endpoint rather than Linux hidraw, evdev or BlueZ L2CAP; neither current Linux realization directly satisfies this backend. Its availability as a Windows reference does not imply that its protocol or calibration model is equivalent to Linux hid-wiimote.

applicability.revision: Pinned software consumer; retail Wii Remote revision not measured
